objective: Test whether specialist delta-review of a strong baseline answer R0 improves final answer R1 more efficiently than full independent rewrites.
flow: DEDUP -> DEPENDENCY_CHECK -> VERIFY -> RED_TEAM -> FUSE_VALIDATED_DELTAS -> R1

specialist_roles.output: Only important missing facts, constraints, cases or implications.
Only concrete errors, contradictions or unjustified claims in R0.
Evidence/provenance needed to strengthen or weaken material claims.
Recompute or independently verify calculations, logic and invariants.
Alternative method or solution that materially changes confidence or result.
Hidden assumptions, missing parameters and scope limits.
Strongest counterexample, failure mode or adversarial challenge.
Remove redundancy and improve clarity without changing truth conditions.

blind_branch.purpose: Reduce anchoring and discover solutions suppressed by R0.

fusion_rules: R0 remains canonical until a delta passes verification.
Same lineage is one evidence family.
Conflicts remain OPEN unless resolved by evidence.
A specialist suggestion is not evidence by itself.
R1 may be worse than R0; benchmark must allow negative delta.

benchmark.pass: Positive cold paired quality gain with no critical-error regression; resource differences reported.
benchmark.contamination: Use frozen cold tasks; do not write test answers into lesson/training memory before scoring.

execution_gate: Requires real callable model/worker executions. Do not simulate unavailable specialists.
